questions.question: How did Dong Zhuo gain more power after Emperor Ling died?
options: He made the young Emperor Xian ruler and controlled him.
He gave up his army and became an adviser.
He helped Liu Bei defeat all the Yellow Turbans.
questions.explanation: 董卓拥立年仅九岁的献帝，并通过控制他获取更多权力。

evidence.quote: Emperor Xian was only nine years old. Dong Zhuo was able to control him and gain much more power.

questions.question: What did Wang Yun suggest doing for the flood victims?
options: Making the farmers leave the empire
Sending food and money and repairing the river's banks
Sending soldiers to take the farmers' remaining crops
questions.explanation: 王允提议送去粮食和钱，并请工程师修复河岸，防止再次发生洪灾。

evidence.quote: I think we should send food and money.

questions.question: What does Dong Zhuo's response to the flood show about him?
options: He is afraid to disagree with the emperor.
He cares more about the farmers than Wang Yun does.
He expects obedience without caring about people's suffering.
questions.explanation: 董卓拒绝救助受灾农民，还威胁他们必须效忠，表现出冷酷和专横。

evidence.quote: We don't need to help them. They'll be loyal—or else!

questions.question: Why did Wang Yun describe the meeting as a birthday party?
options: To hide his plan to discuss removing Dong Zhuo
To persuade the emperor to celebrate with the farmers
To collect birthday gifts for Dong Zhuo
questions.explanation: 生日宴只是掩护；王允不想引起怀疑，实际召集官员商议除掉董卓。

evidence.quote: I only said that to avoid suspicion.

questions.question: What did Cao Cao offer to do at the end of the meeting?
options: Repair the damaged riverbanks himself
Assassinate Dong Zhuo
Ask Dong Zhuo to lead another army
questions.explanation: 当众人还在抱怨董卓势力强大时，曹操主动提出刺杀董卓。

evidence.quote: Leave it to me. I'll assassinate Dong Zhuo.

questions.question: Why does Zella think the mayor is worried about the cave?
options: The mayor wants to explore other worlds alone.
Dangerous relics near Stone Wall could threaten the villagers.
The mayor thinks the children have lost Muncher.
questions.explanation: 洞穴靠近村庄，里面可能有危险遗物；保护村民是市长的职责。

evidence.quote: If King Zanta left a lot of old relics lying around inside, it could be dangerous here.

questions.question: What does Zella want to do after the mayor leaves?
options: Return home and forget about the staff
Ask her teacher to close every wormhole
Sneak back into the cave
questions.explanation: 泽拉想先躲在灌木丛里，等市长离开后再偷偷进洞。

evidence.quote: After she leaves, we can sneak back in.

questions.question: Why does Loro suggest waiting for Zann's reply?
options: Zann may have useful ideas about finding the missing staff.
Zann has promised to bring Muncher home.
Zann is the only person who can speak to the mayor.
questions.explanation: 洛罗认为现在进洞太危险，而且赞恩也许知道怎样寻找失踪的法杖。

evidence.quote: Maybe he has some good ideas about how to find the staff.

questions.question: What makes Zella suspect a connection between the wormhole and the cave?
options: Both were built by her teacher.
The wormhole appeared beside a hidden cave containing a possible relic.
The mayor told her that all caves lead to Fardark.
questions.explanation: 虫洞恰好出现在藏有疑似强大遗物的隐秘洞穴旁，泽拉觉得这可能不是巧合。

evidence.quote: this one appeared right by a hidden cave that had a powerful relic inside.

questions.question: What happens just before the children can decide what to do next?
options: The mayor invites them back into the cave.
Muncher returns carrying the missing staff.
A spy fly delivers a video message from Zann and Perda.
questions.explanation: 洛罗刚提议回村，间谍苍蝇就飞来，给泽拉送来了赞恩和佩尔达的视频消息。

evidence.quote: It's a video message from Zann and Perda!

questions.question: Why is Zing angry with Zann at the beginning?
options: Zann has taken away all his favorite food.
Perda has refused to send a video message.
He must stay at the zoo instead of joining the trip.
questions.explanation: 赞恩的父母不让津随他们去神秘山，要把他留在动物园，他因此发脾气。

evidence.quote: My parents are the ones who said you can't come to Mount Mystery with us.

questions.question: How do Zann and Perda record their message while chasing Zing?
options: They use a spy fly.
They ask Mima to write a letter.
They send a guard back to the palace.
questions.explanation: 佩尔达召来间谍苍蝇，让它一边跟着他们，一边录制视频。

evidence.quote: We can record a video message while we're chasing your goofy dragon.

questions.question: How might a Festian have entered the safe room without being stopped?
options: By turning into a dragon and burning the barriers
By looking like a person who was allowed inside
By using an Invisibility spell in the palace
questions.explanation: 费斯特人能变成其他人类的样子，因此可能冒充有权限的人进入，而不必使用宫内禁止的隐身术。

evidence.quote: maybe a Festian shifted shape to look like someone who was allowed to go in with the relics.

questions.question: How does Zann finally catch Zing?
options: He asks the queen's guards to catch him.
He waits for Zing to fall asleep at the zoo.
He creates a net above Zing and drops it over him.
questions.explanation: 赞恩趁津在树上盯着鸟时，在他上方变出一张网，再让网落下将他罩住。

evidence.quote: When Zann brought his hand down, the net fell right over Zing.

questions.question: What is the main news Zann and Perda want to tell Zella?
options: They will join a group visiting Stone Wall to investigate the cave.
They have already found the missing mask in First City.
They have decided to leave the staff mystery to the mayor.
questions.explanation: 女王派人去石墙村调查洞穴和消失的法杖，赞恩和佩尔达也将同行，第二天一早出发。

evidence.quote: So she's sending a group of people to Stone Wall to check it out.

questions.question: Why is it hard for Swallow to fly at the beginning?
options: The autumn wind is strong and cold.
He is carrying the statue's heavy jewels.
He cannot find the writer's cottage.
questions.explanation: 深秋的风又大又冷，燕子觉得飞行很吃力，因而停在喷泉边休息。

evidence.quote: The late autumn wind blew hard and cold.

questions.question: How does Swallow escape from the hawk?
options: He hides inside the writer's cottage.
He dives into a thick bush.
He flies all the way to Egypt.
questions.explanation: 燕子在空中躲闪后钻进茂密的灌木丛，老鹰没有发现他，飞了过去。

evidence.quote: Finally, he spotted a thick bush and dove into it, trembling.

questions.question: Where does Swallow return to rest after escaping?
options: His flock's tree in Egypt
The writer's warm cottage
The feet of the statue
questions.explanation: 燕子回到雕像身边，蜷缩在雕像脚下睡着了。

evidence.quote: Curling up at the statue's feet, he tucked his head beneath his wing.

questions.question: What is really happening when Swallow sees his flock in Egypt?
options: He is dreaming while asleep near the statue.
The hawk has carried him to Egypt.
His flock has come back to visit the fountain.
questions.explanation: 那是燕子的梦；听到雕像叫他醒来后，他才意识到自己并没有到达埃及。

evidence.quote: Slowly the bird realized he'd been dreaming.

questions.question: Why does the statue cry at the end?
options: Swallow refuses to tell him about the writer.
Swallow is too weak to fly away and may die.
The hawk has stolen the statue's jewels.
questions.explanation: 燕子说自己虚弱得无法飞行，将要离世，雕像为他难过并希望能帮助他。

evidence.quote: I'm too weak

questions.question: How does Nero show Dev that Duke is hurt?
options: He brings Dev a written note.
He plays charades and pretends to fall and limp.
He hides Duke's collar.
questions.explanation: 尼禄通过模仿杜克、假装摔倒和跛行，让德夫明白杜克受了伤。

evidence.quote: And Duke hurt his leg!

questions.question: What do Pam and Dev lift together in the ditch?
options: A large doghouse
A broken gate
A heavy log
questions.explanation: 帕姆独自搬不动木头，德夫下到沟里帮忙，两人才将木头抬起来。

evidence.quote: Finally they lifted the log.

questions.question: Why does Duke stay in the ditch after the log is lifted?
options: He is hurt and cannot get out by himself.
He wants to keep playing in the mud.
He is waiting for a dog treat.
questions.explanation: 杜克仍然受着伤，无法自己离开，需要尼禄把他拉出来。

evidence.quote: He's hurt

questions.question: How does Nero pull Duke to safety?
options: He carries Duke on his back.
He grabs Duke's collar with his teeth.
He pushes the log onto dry ground.
questions.explanation: 尼禄听从德夫的指令，用牙齿咬住杜克的项圈，把他拉到安全的地方。

evidence.quote: Nero grabbed Duke's collar with his teeth.

questions.question: What does Pam's note say about Dev and Nero?
options: They must stop visiting Duke.
They need to practice playing charades.
They have great communication.
questions.explanation: 帕姆认可了他们之间的沟通和默契，在毕业纸条中写下了这一评价。

evidence.quote: Dev and Nero have great communication.

questions.question: Why does Jan ask Daisy to ride Sunny during the lesson?
options: She thinks a successful ride may persuade Jon to keep him.
She wants Daisy to race Sunny against the other horses.
She knows Daisy has never ridden a horse before.
questions.explanation: 简以为黛西是有经验的骑手，希望她能成功骑乘桑尼，让乔恩考虑把桑尼留下。

evidence.quote: If an experienced kid successfully rides Sunny, maybe Jon will consider keeping him.

questions.question: Why does Sunny want to behave well during the lesson?
options: He wants to win a race against Blossom.
He wants Grace to give him a new saddle.
He does not want to return to the dealer's crowded farm.
questions.explanation: 桑尼不喜欢拥挤的马贩农场，那里其他马会抢他的草料，所以他想表现好，留在这里。

evidence.quote: I want to be good so I don't have to leave the farm.

questions.question: According to Jan, what should Daisy do to ask Sunny to walk?
options: Pull hard on the reins
Squeeze her legs without pulling on the reins
Lean back and keep both legs still
questions.explanation: 简教她夹腿示意马前进，同时不要拉缰绳，因为拉缰绳表示停止。

evidence.quote: Daisy will squeeze her legs to ask Sunny to walk.

questions.question: Why does Daisy gulp when Jan asks her to demonstrate a trot?
options: She has only ridden horses at a walk before.
She thinks Grace wants to ride Sunny instead.
She has forgotten Sunny's name.
questions.explanation: 黛西过去在海滩骑马时只走过慢步，还没有快步骑乘的经验，因此紧张。

evidence.quote: On her beach rides, the horses had only walked.

questions.question: What makes Sunny suddenly rush forward at the end?
options: Jan asks him to trot again.
He sees a cat and runs toward it.
Grace drops Blossom's reins.
questions.explanation: 黛西正准备让桑尼转圈时，桑尼看到猫，突然冲了过去。

evidence.quote: The horse burst into motion, rushing toward the cat!
